name: tszm-embedded
description: Z-Machine interpreter (tszm fork) with an embedded runtime target for non-web/non-Node hosts (Snap Spectacles is the first consumer)

scripts.test:minizork: cd test && node run.js games/minizork.z3 minizork-walk.txt
scripts.test:advent: cd test && node run.js games/advent.z5 advent-walk.txt
scripts.test:bundle: npm run build && cd test && TSZM_BUNDLE=1 node run.js games/czech.z5
scripts.test:host: npm run build && cd test && node run-host.js
